system.description: Moving without being seen or heard, and concealing objects and information in ways that resist discovery. Stealth is the art of not being there, or of being there in such a way that nobody notices. The skill of being quiet and small and unremarkable, when that is the only viable option.
system.overcome: Use Stealth to move through a space undetected, conceal an object on your person or in a location, pass a guard or threat without engaging it, or hide effectively under pursuit.
system.caa: Use Stealth to establish positional aspects before a conflict begins - Unseen Behind the Counter, Already In the Room, Nobody Knows I'm Here - that let you set thlaMe terms of an encounter rather than react to them.
system.attack: You can only Attack from Stealth, not with it.
system.defend: Not normally used to Defend, except via a stunt
